mentions.name: App in niche user testing
mentions.description: An app in early validation that the author has tested with niche online groups, friends, and cold outreach to likely users, receiving almost no response so far.
mentions.source_excerpt: Having just tested my app with very niche online groups, friends and cold messaging some people who I thought might have wanted what I'm building, and getting almost no response
